WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_tracks FROM counts
)
SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.track_count, c.track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.avg_tracks, 0) AS ratio
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN avg_count a
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
